name: reelclaw
description: Make TikTok/Reels UGC ads for the product in your repo with real human reaction hooks from DansUGC or your own footage, edited and rendered locally with the reelclaw engine (7 templates + the reelclaw-playbook skill).

interface.shortDescription: UGC ads for the product in your repo: 7 viral templates, rendered locally.
interface.longDescription: Reads your repo to understand the product, finds your demo video, and makes short-form ads with real human creator reactions from the DansUGC library or your own footage. Your agent sets up one local reel project with the open-source reelclaw engine: 7 viral templates (reaction + demo, wall of text, listicle, no yapping, greenscreen reaction, talking-head captions, before/after) and the reelclaw-playbook skill for hooks, footage, music, frame-by-frame QA and variants. The dansugc MCP server supplies the clips, viral-format suggestions, trending music, research and posting; it does not render. Log in with your DansUGC account (OAuth); no API key. Works on any DansUGC account, no plan needed; editing and rendering are free and local; you pay only for clips you don't already own and research queries, and nothing is bought without your explicit yes on the price.
